upload.name: YLTE 1.1.1-beta.6 — Minecraft 1.21.1 / Fabric
upload.changelog: Renamed the independent 1.21.1 ANTE maintenance line to YLTE (Yanling Transit Expansion). Updated loader/UI/diagnostic branding and release filenames; preserved mod ID, script APIs, save keys and protocol 11. Retains beta.5 NeoForge RenderType access transformers and earlier rail/network fixes. The 26.2 ANTE continuation is integrated into YanlingMTR's source/build and remains a different build.
